candidates.description: This vector represents sovereign rulers, royal titles, and supreme forms of government.
This feature vector represents the concept of military invasion, hostile takeover, and territorial conquest.
This feature represents the concept of food, meals, and culinary or dining experiences.
This feature vector represents past-tense cognitive, emotional, and volitional verbs indicating subjective mental states or actions.
This vector represents the concept of quantitative or directional change, encompassing both increases and decreases in magnitude, status, or trend.

This feature vector activates on words related to cultural heritage, ancestry, and traditional customs, with some semantic drift toward vegetables, legal terms, and unrelated vocabulary due to tokenization noise.
This feature vector represents concepts related to legal wrongs, moral transgressions, and the restoration of harm.
This vector represents Latin-derived grammatical suffixes commonly found in taxonomic names, proper nouns, and classical vocabulary.
This vector represents agricultural crops and various food ingredients.
This vector represents the concept of constancy, permanence, and fixity across various linguistic and lexical forms.
